# Cobalt Extensions source templates

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs; do not edit. -->

General-purpose source templates built on Cobalt. Read the relevant complete implementation, types, CSS and local dependencies before reuse. Copy this source tree into `src/components/cobalt-extensions/`, adapt it in the target project, and use relative local imports.

Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions`; it is not a published dependency. Do not create package-name aliases or file dependencies for it. Only official Cobalt/React dependencies belong in the application package manifest. The copied `dependencies.json` lists their pinned baseline.

For source-only reuse, run the HTML Skill script `cobalt-project.mjs copy-source --out <project>`. Workspace scaffolding already copies this directory. The source copy is editable; do not modify the original templates during a design task.

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [AppPage](./app-page/README.md) | A full-viewport page scaffold composed of six sub-components: `AppPage` (root), `AppPageHeader` (top bar), `AppPageMain` (fill area), `AppPageAside` (sidebar), `AppPageContent` (content area), and `AppPageFooter` (pinned footer). `AppPageFooter` can be placed as a direct child of `AppPage` to span the full width, or passed via `AppPageContent`'s `footer` prop to pin it inside the content column only. |
| [Badge](./badge/README.md) | A notification badge that anchors a count or status `Tag` at a configurable corner of any child element — typically used for unread counts on icons or buttons. |
| [BasicTable](./basic-table/README.md) | A type-safe data table with built-in column sorting, pagination, loading skeletons, and empty/error states. Column definitions use a typed `headers` array so TypeScript enforces that `key` matches a field on the row data. |
| [Button](./button/README.md) | A merged button component combining Cobalt `Button` and `StatefulButton` — supports all standard intents (primary / secondary / danger / …) plus an optional async `state` for loading, success, and error feedback. |
| [Card](./card/README.md) | A surface container with a fixed Cobalt drop-shadow + 1px inset border. Only `padding`, `margin`, `width`, and `height` are configurable — the visual style is locked to the design spec. |
| [ChipGroup](./chip-group/README.md) | A compact horizontal group of tag chips that collapses overflow into a clickable `+N` chip with a popup of the remaining items. |
| [Choice](./choice/README.md) | A single checkbox or radio control with a clickable label and built-in `error` / `warning` outline states. Use `FormField` when you need a description, hint message, or label-above layout. |
| [Collapse](./collapse/README.md) | Layout container that animates a content panel open and closed when the user clicks the header. Use it to hide secondary information until needed. |
| [ConfirmModal](./confirm-modal/README.md) | A modal dialog component that presents a confirmation prompt with an icon, descriptive content, a cancel button, and a primary action button. |
| [DatePicker](./date-picker/README.md) | A date input that opens a Cobalt calendar popup and returns a plain JS `Date` — no manual `{ year, month, day }` conversion required. |
| [DateRangePicker](./date-range-picker/README.md) | A date-range input that opens a Cobalt calendar popup for selecting start and end dates, accepting and returning `{ startDate, endDate }` as plain JS `Date` values. |
| [DateTimePicker](./date-time-picker/README.md) | A date-and-time input that opens a popup combining a Cobalt calendar with an hour/minute stepper, returning a single JS `Date`. |
| [Dialog](./dialog/README.md) | A modal dialog component with a structured header (title + optional subtitle + X close button), a scrollable content area, and a footer with cancel and confirm actions. |
| [Dropdown](./dropdown/README.md) | A single-select dropdown that renders a list of options and supports fully customisable option rows via per-option or global render functions — backed by the Cobalt Marketplace dropdown. |
| [FormField](./form-field/README.md) | A labeled form field that adds a required marker, prefix/suffix decorators, character counter, static description, and validation hints around any input control passed as `children`. |
| [Input](./input/README.md) | A naked text-input control built on Cobalt `Input`. For labels, descriptions, hints, and character counters, compose with `FormField` externally. |
| [InteractiveMessage](./interactive-message/README.md) | A status message banner for `info`, `success`, `warning`, and `error` feedback, with optional icon, dismiss button, loading spinner, and action button. |
| [MultiDropdown](./multi-dropdown/README.md) | A multi-select dropdown that renders a list of options as toggleable rows and shows the selection as removable tags in the trigger — with support for fully customisable option rows via per-option or global render functions. |
| [PopupTrigger](./popup-trigger/README.md) | A wrapper component that attaches a floating popup panel to any element — wrap a button, icon, link, or any React node as `children` to make it open the popup on click. |
| [SelectGroup](./select-group/README.md) | A button-group selector supporting single-select and multi-select modes as a fully controlled component via `options`, `value`, and `onChange`. |
| [SidePanel](./side-panel/README.md) | The default and `form` variants retain a row title container. The opt-in `participants` variant keeps its column title/subtitle container and dedicated spacing and typography; restoring the default layout does not change it. |
| [Stepper](./stepper/README.md) | A vertical timeline indicator that renders a list of steps — each with a `status` dot (`complete`, `active`, `error`, or `idle`) — connected by lines. |
| [Textarea](./textarea/README.md) | A naked multi-line text-input control built on Cobalt `Textarea`. For labels, descriptions, hints, and character counters, compose with `FormField` externally. |
| [TimeSelectInput](./time-select-input/README.md) | A compact time-picker control that renders adjacent hours and minutes inputs with an optional AM/PM toggle, expressing its value as total minutes from midnight. |
| [TimezoneDropdown](./timezone-dropdown/README.md) | A searchable dropdown for selecting an IANA timezone, grouped by country/region. |
| [ToolbarWrapper](./toolbar-wrapper/README.md) | A horizontal toolbar container with a `gray100` background, a `start` slot on the left and an `end` slot on the right, and an optional bottom divider. Use it to build list headers, filter bars, and date-navigation bars above content areas. |
| [Typography](./typography/README.md) | A single text component that switches between Cobalt `Heading` and `Text` via a semantic `variant` prop, with overrides for level, weight, font, color tone, and skeleton loading. |
| [UploadFile](./upload-file/README.md) | A drag-and-drop / click-to-browse file upload field that toggles between an empty drop zone and a selected-file preview card. It renders two distinct states: an empty drop zone when no file is selected, and a file card when a file has been chosen. Drag-over triggers a visual highlight on the drop zone border and background. |
